questions.question: What did God say He would pour out on the house of David and the people of Jerusalem?

answers.text: A spirit of grace and prayer

questions.question: God said the people of Jerusalem would mourn for the One they had pierced as one mourns for an only child. True or false?
God said a fountain would be opened to the house of David and the people of Jerusalem. What would it cleanse them from?
God said He would bring the third of the people left in the land through the fire. What would He do with them there?

answers.text: Refine them like silver and test them like gold
Burn them away from the land for good
Punish them and then leave them behind
